title: EARLIER ( column, 2 ) reads the row context two levels out
query: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS ( T, "x", SUMX ( FILTER ( T, T[n] >= 2 ), SUMX ( FILTER ( T, T[n] = 1 ), EARLIER ( T[n], 2 ) ) ) )

source.quote: If you need to get a value from the loop before that, set the second argument to 2.
source.supports: the second argument selects the loop before the previous one

source.quote: The next evaluation level out is represented by 1; two levels out is represented by 2 and so on. When omitted default value is 1.

derivation: Two levels out of the inner SUMX is ADDCOLUMNS. The outer SUMX has 2 rows (n = 2, 3) and the inner SUMX 1 row, so the ADDCOLUMNS value is added twice: 1 gives 2, 2 gives 4, 3 gives 6.
